title: Donor Summary
bodyHtml:
Donor Summary Tool

The Donor Summary tool provides interactive visualizations of available data types and metadata for the 532 pancreatic donors with data currently included in PanKbase. These donors are from a larger set of all 3,737 donors in external programs including HPAP, IIDP, nPOD, ADI and Prodo.

Metadata fields have been harmonized across programs by experts, and detailed descriptions of metadata variables and standards are listed here. To view more comprehensive metadata for each donor visit the Data Library.

For each data type currently included in PanKbase, links are provided to interactive tools and visualizations for that data type, as well as to the uniformly processed data files in the Data Library.
